title: “Software is over”: Bold AI developer takes aim at Adobe with open source clones
script:
An artificial intelligence developer just took aim at Adobe with open source clones.
These Opus built Creative Cloud alternatives are ambitious and completely free.
The catch is that the software is still nowhere near finished.
Would you try an open source alternative to Creative Cloud?
